items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: Because I was a brother on bass, I was drum. Nelson Joe was on banjo.

ctx.x: Quite long. Because I was a brother on bass, I was drum.

Nelson Joe was on banjo. Willie Joe was on clarinet. And I believe it was a trumpet. And I believe it was Walter Donovan was on trumpet. I forget it's been so long, you know. And you can't remember the trombone player's name, huh? No. I can't think of what it was. Yeah. I can't remember what it was. Yeah. And you can't remember the trombone player's name, huh? No. I can't remember what it was. I think it was a fellow initiative.
